<module id="accu">
	<description>Implement a module to accumulate input data sequentially until four data points have been received, then output the accumulated value.</description>
	<ports>
	    <input id="clk">Clock input.</input>
		<input id="rst_n">Active-low reset signal.</input>
		<input id="data_in" width_description="[7:0]">8-bit input data.</input>
		<input id="valid_in">Valid input signal.</input>
		
		<output id="valid_out">Output valid signal.</output>
		<output id="data_out" width_description="[9:0]">10-bit output data.</output>
	endports
	
	<implementation>
        // Define internal registers and counter
        reg [9:0] accumulator;
        reg [2:0] counter;      // 4-bit counter to keep track of the number of received inputs
        reg [9:0] temp_sum;     // Temporary variable to store the accumulated sum
        reg [2:0] valid_in_counter;       // Counter to keep track of valid_in cycles
        
        // Sequential logic block triggered on the rising edge of the clock or active low reset
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if (~rst_n) begin
                // Reset all registers and flags on reset
                accumulator <= 10'd0;
                counter <= 3'd0;
                temp_sum <= 10'd0;
                valid_in_counter <= 3'd0;
            end else begin
                // Check if valid_in is asserted (data is ready to be added)
                if (valid_in == 1'b1) begin
                    // Add the incoming data to the accumulator
                    accumulator <= accumulator + data_in;
                    
                    // Increment the counter to track the number of valid inputs received
                    counter <= counter + 1'b1;
                    // Check if we've received enough inputs (4 inputs)
                    if (counter == 3'd4) begin
                        // Store the accumulated sum in temp_sum
                        temp_sum <= accumulator;
                        // Set the valid_out flag to indicate the accumulated data is available
                        valid_out <= 1'b1;
                        // Reset the accumulator and counter for the next set of inputs
                        accumulator <= 10'd0;
                        counter <= 3'd0;
                    end else begin
                        // Not yet enough inputs, so set valid_out to 0
                        valid_out <= 1'b0;
                    end
                end else begin
                    // No valid input received, so set valid_out to 0
                    valid_out <= 1'b0;
                end
            end
        end
		
		// Assign the final accumulated value to the data_out port
        assign data_out = temp_sum;
        
        // Count the number of valid_in cycles for proper timing control
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if (~rst_n) begin
                valid_in_counter <= 3'd0;
            end else begin
                if (valid_in == 1'b1 && valid_in_counter < 3'd4) begin
                    valid_in_counter <= valid_in_counter + 1'b1;
                end else if (valid_in_counter >= 3'd4) begin
